turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
Quick how-to (the parts that matter most): apply a very light coat of Whisper Light™ and let it get tacky (about 30–60 seconds), then use the Fuse Control® Wand to place each Gossamer® on the underside of your upper lashes, leaving about 1–2 mm away from the waterline.
Pro tip for wear time: after you apply, try to keep them dry while the bond sets (give it 12–24 hours before getting them wet).
Are your natural lashes pretty straight, or do they have some curl already?
Straight lashes
Some curl
